ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:18; the visible surface is characterized by a high-intensity white pixel area (localized to barnacle clusters) occupying roughly 5% of the total surface against a 95% low-intensity black pixel background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is a uniform low-intensity black field. High-contrast white circular pixel blobs are spatially mapped to the extreme lateral tips (coordinates 0-5% and 95-100% of horizontal width) and scattered along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 14% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant irregular serration across both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 4 to 15 pixels relative to a fitted polynomial edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature originating from the median notch and terminating in acute, upwardly swept lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of roughly circular white pixel aggregates concentrated on the distal lateral tips and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A cluster of four distinct, light-grey linear pixel disruptions oriented horizontally/diagonally on the medial portion of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on both the left and right distal tips of the fluke.
